Ground Beef Chili Recipe | Instant Pot Recipes
By: A Kitchen Advisor
Published: Thursday, February 28, 2019 - 9:11am

Ingredients




1 tablespoon vegetable oil
1 diced onion
2 pounds ground beef
1 tablespoon salt
1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper
3 tablespoon chili powder, or to taste
1 tablespoon ground cumin
1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon
2 teaspoon paprika
1/4 teaspoon dried oregano
1/4 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper
1 chili pepper
1 cup wine
2 cans (19 fl oz) black beans, drained and rinsed well
1 can (28 fl oz) tomatoes, crushed
1 cup beef broth or water
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 diced green or red bell pepper

Preparation

1 Combine ground black pepper, chili powder, salt , cumin, cinnamon, paprika, ground cayenne pepper and oregano. Set the spice mixture aside. 2 Select (Sauté) program and set Mode Indicator to "More". Adjust time to 30 minutes. 3 Pour vegetable oil. 4 Add onion, stir well and sauté it for 3 minutes. 5 Stir in ground beef, crash it into small pieces and sauté it for another 7 minutes. 6 Add bell pepper, minced garlic, tomatoes, wine, beef broth or water. 7 Wash and drain the beans, then add the beans and spices into the pot. 8 Here comes a special ingredient which brings spiciness to this meal - a chili pepper. 9 Close the lid and turn the steam release handle to "Sealing" position. Cancel (Sauté) program. 10 Press “Bean/Chili” program and go with the default settings (pressure mode "High" and time 30 min). 11 When time is up, open the pressure cooker using Natural Release (allow the steam escape gradually from the inner pot, do NOT turn the steam release handle on the lid to “Venting” position). 12 Your Ground Beef Chili recipe is done. Serve immediately, garnished with sour cream and cilantro.

About

Make a Ground Beef Chili recipe in Instant Pot. The best Chili Recipe is hearty, chunky, and absolutely comforting!  Also it is made extremely easy with the kind assistance of your pressure cooker. This is a classic dump and go meal and this is exactly why we love Instant Pot: you put all the ingredients in and let the multicooker do all the work for you!
This time there is no any secret ingredient. Just don't forget to add chili pepper at the end, so you will  bring extra spiciness. Chili pepper makes this Ground Beef Chili recipe so special.
